verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents AuthKit as a "customizable hosted UI for authentication". The React SDK handles sign-in and sign-up through a hosted flow. Framework integrations add auth components and helpers: Astro auth components, Next.js helpers, and Laravel starter kits with AuthKit built in. That covers the sign-in and sign-up core of the story with prebuilt hosted pages and components. missing for 10: evidence of prebuilt profile/account-management UI or widgets, detail on how far the hosted UI can be customized (branding/theming), independent hands-on corroboration of the hosted UI in production.
